text_block_list.text:
While walking along the riverbank, a canoe pulled up to the shore,
and an Umamusume stepped out, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We've made it to the new continent! To survive in uncharted territory...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
――What is it that's missing?!
You over there, answer me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What a coincidence, I was thinking the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, to commemorate this, I'll teach you
a trick to building stamina. Wanna hear it?
choice_data_list: I'd like you to teach me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's something... you gotta find for yourself!
It only has meaning if you discover it on your own...
Gold Ship climbed back into the canoe and continued paddling down the river...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To survive in harsh environments,
tenacity is key...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
When you think sticky... natto!
Which means, if I eat natto...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
By the way, natto gets fluffier and tastier
if you give it a good mix before adding the soy sauce☆
Gold Ship climbed back into the canoe and continued paddling down the river...
